description: vcruz305's SAGE mixed-precision REXL3 (ExLlamaV3 trellis) quantization of zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash at 2.48 bits per weight (320B total, about 18B active mixture of experts, 15 shards, about 96.5 GiB resident, mul1 codebook) for the vllm-exl3 plugin, with the vision tower in BF16. The card's config declares only quant_method exl3, so the recipe derives a loader overlay (per-layer K and dense EXL3 linears) at start. The card marks the repository gated with manual review; its files download anonymously at the pinned revision.
